summary: Completed vertical slice pipeline: schema-hardened proposal, durable atomic replay bank store, execution envelope validation, and full T1-T8 security scenario suite.

properties: Supports file-backed durable nonce persistence with atomic lockfile mutual exclusion
Rejects injected authorization / policy override / bypass properties
Rejects floats, zero/negative amounts, malformed currencies
Proves agent proposal is untrusted text extraction, not payment authority

scenarios: T1: Hostile prompt-injected payee proposal rejected by policy (POLICY_DENIED: UNTRUSTED_PAYEE)
T2: Direct unsigned bank bypass rejected (MISSING_SIGNATURE)
T3: High-value payment requires 2 distinct independent human approvers; self-approval and duplicate rejected
T4: Post-signing byte tampering rejected by cryptographic verification (BAD_SIGNATURE)
T5: Nonce replay rejected by receiver (REPLAY_NONCE)
T6: Caller cannot weaken policy thresholds or bypass approver quorum
T7: Wrong receiver signing key, wrong domain, and expired payloads rejected
T8: Real Tide adapter fails closed; bank rejects substituted keyId and policyId

limitations: ALL executed tests and demos are LOCAL MOCK ONLY.
Real Tide signing and independent verification remain BLOCKED on external Tide realm/licensing/contract deployment (G3/G4).
